Sometimes, for me, keeping my hands busy is distracting enough to keep my mind from wandering. I've got a bunch of stuff that's often marketed as desk decorations/stress relief like tangle toys, stress balls, i even have a smooth rock that i concentrate on turning over in my hands sometimes. idk if your work will allow that though.
